title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: As per Vennila's plan, Anbu's employee falsely accuses him of misbehaving with her. Later, Mathangi states the accusation and firmly insists on taking Kanmani back home.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: At Yercaud, Nalini senses Siddharth's lethal plan. As Ilamathi and Paraman enjoy their trip, Kalamma tricks Kumaresan into dropping Ashok's murder case.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri and Prabhakaran successfully trap Manickam with a fake passport scheme. Manickam reveals the reason for blackmailing Karna and agrees to assist them in exposing him.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Villagers pressure Poongodi and Azhagar to participate in the newlyweds' festival contest. Though unwilling, they join hands and take part in the Rangoli competition together.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Shruthi asks Bagyaraj and Suresh to cancel her wedding plans, and they agree to do so with a valid reason. Later, Malar warns Shruthi to forget Karthi and obey her parents.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Suganya tearfully bids Palanivel farewell as she leaves for her delivery. Meanwhile, Gomathi helps Meena and Raji reconcile, proposing a bangle ceremony for Thangamayil.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: As Chandayatha longs for her family, Cheran comforts her and spends a romantic moment with her. Later, the family watches a movie on TV while enjoying snacks made by her.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu excitedly invites his family to his new office opening. Touched by Vijaya's quiet praise and well-wishes, he later joins Meena to drive the kids in their van.

title: Chinna Marumagal
episodeTitle: Sethupathi Sets a Test for Karuppu
description: Aishwarya firmly refuses to carry out Eshwari's task, despite the risk of being exposed. Sethupathi sets a trap for Karuppu to test his loyalty over the secret information leak.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun saves Madhu from rogues and gets injured, bringing them closer. Meanwhile, Kasthuri leaves for college and Kamala demands that she clean up a mess.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Sarasu expresses her happiness to Indhira after enjoying the feast. A customer takes advantage of the QR machine failure at Kandhasamy's mess to leave without paying the bill.

title: Bigg Boss
description: Clashes, tears and tough calls! Shama-Jason fight halts the task, but Avinash wins big. Asmitha struggles with Anandhi, while the exit board results leave Shathiga in tears.
